qualification: #279 confirms occupied-map updates during recorded force-driven motion and one exact same-epoch ready MapStatus/cloud archive with exact float32 PCD readback. The saved snapshot was captured after the driver-recorded motion interval. Geometry and trajectory values are exploratory diagnostics; this does not pass GOAL B/C/F, obstacle avoidance, or final A–H acceptance.

scope.world: Run-local debug-motion.sdf derived from simulation/worlds/sensor_calibration.sdf with a calibration box and cylinder.
scope.truth: The motion driver recorded Gazebo pose only for offline alignment. VINS, localization, depth gate, mapping, EGO, and probes did not subscribe to truth.
scope.control: No PX4, controller, goal client, or control publisher was launched; both runs used manual EGO WAIT_TARGET mode.
scope.odometry_wiring_audit: #247, #273, #275, and #277 launch scripts used odometry_topic:=odom instead of /localization/optimized_imu_odom; EGO states from those runs do not establish planner readiness. #278 and #279 used the adapter output topic.

EGO.interpretation: Correct topic wiring is verified, but the timeout source is unresolved; these logs do not demonstrate planner readiness.

ego_build_provenance.qualification: These dynamic runs used the Oct 16 prebuilt EGO underlay. The current pinned vendor source was separately rebuilt in #280; #281 uses that fresh overlay.

interpretation: During the driver-recorded motion interval [7.328, 32.342] s, 264 observer clock-aligned map samples had 778–1229 occupied points, 92 unique counts, and 122 point-count changes. This shows online map output changing during motion, not map coverage or geometric correctness.

The archived #279 snapshot was captured at source stamp 34.061 s, after the motion driver recorded motion through 32.342 s. MapStatus and cloud share epoch, map_id, frame, source stamp, and 1191 point count; the ready MapStatus header is 62 ms later. The observer recorded /clock at 34.058 s on receipt, 3 ms before the cloud stamp; this probe-side reading does not substitute for adapter-internal clock instrumentation.
PCD archive contains occupied points only. All 1191 float32 coordinates read back exactly. The map does not represent exported free/unknown voxels.

Single fixed-scale SE(3) offline alignment gives 379 paired trajectory samples, position RMSE 8.16 mm, P95 14.93 mm, maximum 16.16 mm, and orientation RMSE 0.955°. This is one diagnostic alignment against offline truth, not a final localization threshold.

Within 0.25 m ROIs, the box has 45 points with 5.56 cm P95 surface residual; the cylinder has 31 points with 11.00 cm P95 and 70.97% within 10 cm. These sparse single-run samples do not establish map coverage or avoidance clearance.

EGO was wired to /localization/optimized_imu_odom in #279 and reached WAIT_TARGET, but logged 51 odom/depth timeout warnings from simulation time 15.451 to 34.651 s. No goal was sent and the timeout source remains unresolved.

Version audit: #278/#279 used the Oct 16 prebuilt EGO binaries from the base install; their timeout/INIT behavior is not a current-vendor source result. #280 rebuilt the current pinned EGO packages, and #281 is the current-source no-goal follow-up; see progress/evidence/p2-ego-current-vendor-runtime-20261020-280-281.json.
limitations: #278 is excluded: localization locked telemetry_stale within 0.823 s of the observation window and an exact ready MapStatus/cloud sample was not retained.
#279 snapshot time is after the motion driver recorded interval; map count changes during motion show update activity only.
Only occupied points from one sample were archived. Free/unknown state, map coverage, persistence across views, clear-path classification, inflation safety, and collision clearance remain unverified.
The geometry ROIs are limited to 0.25 m around two ideal obstacles and contain only 45/31 points; no formal F acceptance threshold was applied.
EGO timeout warnings under correct topic wiring remain unexplained. EGO stayed WAIT_TARGET without goal or trajectory, so planner response and avoidance are untested.
No PX4, controller, truth input, or flight acceptance was part of these runs; no acceptance thresholds were changed.
EGO behavior in #278/#279 came from the Oct 16 prebuilt binary, not the freshly rebuilt current locked vendor source; #281 provides one current-source recheck.
next_step: Trace the EGO occupancy/pose input callback boundary in a correct-topic no-goal run; then define and measure map coverage/free-unknown and clear-path behavior with explicit reviewable thresholds before any avoidance acceptance.

follow_up_current_vendor_run.finding: The current-source run #281 had zero odom/depth timeout warnings over 35.015 s; no causal explanation is established.
